objective: Preallocate column-scan aggregate states for their first collected input value.

tasks.title: Preallocate column-scan aggregate first input
tasks.result: Column-scan aggregate states now reserve capacity for the first collected string or distinct value.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
An initial cargo test invocation passed two test filters and failed before running tests; verification was rerun with the correct module filter.
The initial capacity is 1 because column-scan aggregate states are created before receiving their first matching row value.
The optimization only changes initial HashSet/Vec allocation for collecting column-scan states; decoding, NULL handling, grouping, finalization, and SQL results are unchanged.
